author: FluidSim
description: Adds controlled tangential motion around a chosen axis, with optional suction and lift. Use the owned controller Empty to place the vortex directly in the Blender scene.

kernels.description: Adds bounded tangential, radial, and axial acceleration to live liquid particles.
kernels.label: Apply Vortex
kernels.source:
offset = position - controller
axis_length = wp.length(axis)
distance = wp.length(offset)
if axis_length > 1.0e-6 and distance < radius:
    axis_n = axis / axis_length
    radial = offset - axis_n * wp.dot(offset, axis_n)
    radial_length = wp.length(radial)
    if radial_length > 1.0e-6:
        influence = wp.clamp(1.0 - radial_length / radius, 0.0, 1.0)
        tangent = wp.normalize(wp.cross(axis_n, radial))
        updated = particle_velocity[particle_index]
        updated = updated + tangent * (strength * influence * solver_time_step)
        updated = updated - radial * (suction * influence * solver_time_step)
        updated = updated + axis_n * (lift * influence * solver_time_step)
        particle_velocity[particle_index] = updated

name: Vortex Force

parameters.description: Scene object whose origin places the vortex center.
parameters.label: Controller

parameters.description: Local swirl axis in world space.
parameters.label: Axis

parameters.description: Tangential acceleration at the controller center.
parameters.label: Strength

parameters.description: Radial pull toward the vortex axis.
parameters.label: Suction

summary: Swirl liquid around an artist-positioned controller with radial falloff.

author: FluidSim
description: Applies a smooth trigonometric curl-style velocity perturbation. The effect is deterministic for a given seed, position, time, and stack order and requires no topology rebuild.

kernels.description: Adds deterministic spatially varying motion without changing particle positions directly.
kernels.label: Apply Turbulence
kernels.source:
sample = position * frequency + wp.vec3(seed, seed * 1.37, seed * 2.11)
phase = time * drift
noise = wp.vec3(
    wp.sin(sample[1] + phase) - wp.sin(sample[2] - phase),
    wp.sin(sample[2] + phase * 1.17) - wp.sin(sample[0] - phase),
    wp.sin(sample[0] + phase * 0.73) - wp.sin(sample[1] - phase * 1.31),
)
particle_velocity[particle_index] = particle_velocity[particle_index] + noise * (strength * solver_time_step)

name: Curl Turbulence

parameters.description: Animation rate of the turbulence pattern.
parameters.label: Drift

summary: Add deterministic, animated divergence-like turbulent motion to particles.

author: FluidSim
description: Creates a controllable spherical impulse field around an owned Empty. Positive strength pushes outward; negative strength pulls inward, with a smooth linear falloff to the radius.

kernels.description: Applies a bounded radial acceleration around the controller origin.
kernels.label: Apply Pulse
kernels.source:
offset = position - controller
distance = wp.length(offset)
if distance > 1.0e-6 and distance < radius:
    influence = wp.clamp(1.0 - distance / radius, 0.0, 1.0)
    direction = offset / distance
    particle_velocity[particle_index] = particle_velocity[particle_index] + direction * (strength * influence * solver_time_step)

name: Radial Pulse

parameters.description: Scene object whose origin places the pulse center.
parameters.label: Controller

summary: Push or pull liquid radially from a controller with a finite radius.

author: FluidSim
description: Uses a controller origin and world-space normal to push particles away from a plane. The finite width makes the effect easy to art-direct without global scene impact.

kernels.description: Pushes current particles to opposing sides of the configured plane.
kernels.label: Apply Split
kernels.source:
normal_length = wp.length(normal)
if normal_length > 1.0e-6:
    normal_n = normal / normal_length
    signed_distance = wp.dot(position - controller, normal_n)
    absolute_distance = wp.abs(signed_distance)
    if absolute_distance < width:
        side = 1.0
        if signed_distance < 0.0:
            side = -1.0
        influence = wp.clamp(1.0 - absolute_distance / width, 0.0, 1.0)
        particle_velocity[particle_index] = particle_velocity[particle_index] + normal_n * (side * strength * influence * solver_time_step)

name: Planar Split

parameters.description: Scene object whose origin places the split plane.
parameters.label: Controller

parameters.description: World-space normal of the split plane.
parameters.label: Plane Normal

parameters.description: Half-width of the plane influence band.
parameters.label: Width

summary: Separate liquid to opposite sides of an artist-positioned plane.

author: FluidSim
description: Applies stable per-substep velocity damping to the current liquid particle. Use it to settle motion, tame injected energy, or create a localized viscous-looking art direction layer.

kernels.description: Scales each current particle velocity by a bounded timestep-aware factor.
kernels.label: Damp Velocity
kernels.source:
factor = wp.clamp(1.0 - damping * solver_time_step, 0.0, 1.0)
particle_velocity[particle_index] = particle_velocity[particle_index] * factor

name: Velocity Damping
summary: Reduce particle velocity smoothly without changing solver topology.

author: FluidSim
description: A two-kernel effect: the first applies lift after particle-to-grid transfer; the second cools temperature after particle update. It demonstrates one artist effect spanning two solver stages.

kernels.description: Converts excess particle temperature into directional acceleration.
kernels.label: Apply Thermal Lift
kernels.source:
direction_length = wp.length(direction)
if direction_length > 1.0e-6:
    direction_n = direction / direction_length
    excess = particle_temperature[particle_index] - ambient
    particle_velocity[particle_index] = particle_velocity[particle_index] + direction_n * (excess * buoyancy * solver_time_step)

kernels.description: Returns particle temperature toward ambient after advection.
kernels.label: Cool Particle Temperature
kernels.source:
factor = wp.clamp(1.0 - cooling * solver_time_step, 0.0, 1.0)
particle_temperature[particle_index] = ambient + (particle_temperature[particle_index] - ambient) * factor

name: Temperature Lift

parameters.description: Acceleration per temperature unit above ambient.
parameters.label: Buoyancy

parameters.description: Rate at which temperature returns to ambient.
parameters.label: Cooling

summary: Convert particle temperature into buoyant lift and cool it after advection.

author: FluidSim
description: Limits the magnitude of each liquid particle velocity while preserving direction. This is a predictable utility for art direction and for guarding aggressive custom-force stacks.

kernels.description: Clamps current-particle speed without changing velocity direction.
kernels.label: Limit Speed
kernels.source:
current = particle_velocity[particle_index]
speed = wp.length(current)
if speed > maximum_speed:
    particle_velocity[particle_index] = current * (maximum_speed / speed)

name: Particle Speed Limit
summary: Clamp particle speeds to an explicit artist-controlled maximum.

author: FluidSim
description: Runs on active sparse voxels and therefore requests topology. It provides a clear example of a grid-domain effect whose cadence is once per frame rather than every solver substep.

kernels.description: Relaxes temperature on active non-collision voxels once per display frame.
kernels.label: Cool Active Voxels
kernels.source:
factor = wp.clamp(1.0 - cooling * real_time_step, 0.0, 1.0)
temperature[flat_voxel_index] = ambient + (temperature[flat_voxel_index] - ambient) * factor

name: Voxel Cooling
summary: Relax active-grid temperature toward ambient once per frame.
